items.title: David Finck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 29, 2015
items.q: I was fortunate enough to do a lot of worker for a producer named Phil Ramone, and Phil called me for a lot of things.

ctx.x: So why do you get those calls — in your mind?

Well it depended on the music and the producer. First of all I show up on time. There’s a lot of money at stake when somebody’s making a record. Like those “Rod Stewart Sings Standards” records. They spent a fortune. You can’t come walking in even five minutes late to a session. So you need a good reputation in that department.
